outcome: Morbidity (length of stay, TPN duration, days to full feeds)
cohort: The study included 24 infants born with gastroschisis in Egypt.
finding: Mortality among infants with gastroschisis in Egypt is very high, mainly due to sepsis and prematurity, and is linked to young maternal age and poor socioeconomic status, with the Gastroschisis Prognostic Score (GPS) being a good indicator of morbidity and mortality.
followup_time: Up to 52 days (median length of hospital stay was 14 days, ranging 1-52 days, or until mortality)
